name: paperclip
description: The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work
one_liner: An open-source dashboard where you hire a team of AI agents (a CEO, engineers, marketers) to run a business goal for you, and watch them work like a company org chart.
buyer: A solo founder or small agency owner who wants to run several AI-driven side projects at once without personally managing each agent's prompts and logs.
business_use_cases: A solo founder assigns 'grow my newsletter to 10k subscribers' as a goal and lets an agent team draft content, post, and report back weekly.
An agency reselling 'AI employee' setups to small businesses uses it as the backend dashboard clients log into to see what their AI team did.
A bootstrapped SaaS builder runs a virtual 'CTO + 2 engineers' crew to review and merge low-risk pull requests overnight.

money_ideas.idea: Hosted version with managed agent credentials and billing per active agent-seat.
Done-for-you setup service configuring the org chart and budgets for a client's first AI team.

steal_this: Stand up a self-hosted instance this weekend, wire in one real API key, and offer 'AI ops manager' as a $500 setup service to a local small business.
